findings.issue: Chat revisions acquire busy, but version rollback buttons neither honor nor acquire that lock. A rollback can run during a chat revision (including image filling/auditing), and chat can start during rollback; competing writes and preview updates can replace the user's requested result. Include rollback controls and their handler in the shared busy boundary.

The chat availability guard reuses currentDeckVersion from the previous project when createProject changes currentProjectId. If the new generation fails, chat remains enabled for a project without a deck, retaining the previous project's conversation and unsent instruction. Reset project-specific shell state after successful project creation, before assigning the new ID.

summary: Fixed two medium-severity defects: chat and rollback now share the busy lock through completion, and successful project creation resets stale deck/chat state while failed creation preserves the existing project. Three new regressions failed before the fixes; Git Bash npm run check now passes all six legacy test entrypoints and all nine DOM tests. No push or deployment was performed.
